name: hakeem
caption:
HAKEEM'S LAST SEASON WAS WITH US 🎮🏀

• Houston legend: 2 titles, 2 Finals MVPs (1994, 1995)
• Aug 2, 2001: he turned down $13 million from the Rockets, and Houston traded him to us for draft picks
• His deal with us: 3 years, $18 million
• With us: 7.1 points and 6.0 rebounds a night, the lowest of his career
• Fall 2002: he retired with a bad back, the NBA's all-time leader in blocks (3,830)

Did you know The Dream played for us? 👇

beats.head: THE DREAM
beats.name: HAKEEM
beats.vo: Two titles. Two Finals MVPs. And Hakeem Olajuwon's last NBA season? He played it for us.

beats.head: DID YOU KNOW?

facts.claim: Hakeem Olajuwon: 2 NBA titles and 2 Finals MVPs (1994, 1995) with Houston. On August 2, 2001 (Aug 2, 2001), after refusing a $13 million (13M) deal with the Rockets, he was traded to the Toronto Raptors for draft picks, on a three-year (3 years) contract worth $18 million (18M). With Toronto in 2001-02 he averaged career lows of 7.1 points and 6.0 rebounds per game in his final NBA season and retired in the fall of 2002 with a back injury, the all-time leader in blocked shots with 3,830 (3830). ESPN id 619.
